    The settings of the xgboost fits

    xgbSettings.Rd

    The one place the boosting settings of the ignition and the escape fits are put together, from the module's xgb* parameters; the defaults are the values the fits were hard-coded with before (nrounds = 100, max_depth = 2, learning_rate = 0.15, reg_lambda = 0.5, no early stopping), so a fit with the default parameters is the one made before they existed. runXGBOOST() and fitFoldXgboost() take this list as it is, so a setting is never listed twice.

    xgbSettings(
  maxDepth = 2,
  learningRate = 0.15,
  nrounds = 100,
  regLambda = 0.5,
  earlyStopping = NA
)

    Arguments

    maxDepth, learningRate, regLambda

    xgboost's max_depth, learning_rate and reg_lambda.

    nrounds

    xgboost's nrounds: the number of boosting rounds, or, with earlyStopping, their cap.

    earlyStopping

    NA (or NULL, 0): off. Otherwise xgboost's early_stopping_rounds: each fold's boosting stops once the held-out fold's Poisson loss (poisson-nloglik, the deviance up to a constant) has not improved for this many rounds, and the fold's model keeps the best round.

    Value

    A named list: max_depth, learning_rate, reg_lambda, nrounds and, only with early stopping, early_stopping_rounds (so an unset one adds nothing to the fit's cache key).
